subject: Acme Data – vendor activation: SLA & PO intake kickoff
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Acme Data Procurement <procurement@acmedata.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Oct 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Acme Data – vendor activation: SLA & PO intake kickoff

Hi Tom / Acme procurement team,

Thanks again for selecting Redwood for inference for Acme’s analytics platform — excited to get you live. Procurement asked I kick off an intake so Finance and Cloud Ops have everything they need to activate the account and wire up billing. Key things we need from your side to move to PO and support activation: 

- Vendor questionnaire (we’ve attached our standard items in case you want to copy fields).
- Confirm primary invoicing contact + billing email and PO routing rules (do you require a PO number on the invoice, and what billing terms do you expect?).
- Support & escalation details: primary support contact, on-call escalation for sev1, paging windows (PST/UTC), and an SLA target for uptime and response (we typically propose 99.9% and 1-hr sev1 acknowledgement for Dedicated customers, but happy to align).
- Any required security evidence (SOC 2, encryption at rest keys, IP allowlist ranges) we should submit now to avoid delays.

Can you please share an estimated date when procurement can sign the PO and the email addresses we should use for invoices and support notifications? If easier, we can do a 20-min call this week to walk through the items.

Next steps on our side: Laura will own the PO intake and vendor setup; Dylan will share the onboarding checklist for support routing and SSO/service accounts once we have the contacts.

Thanks — Priya

--
Priya Natarajan
Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0189

Attachments: redwood_vendor_questionnaire_template.pdf (PDF, 18KB)
From: Tom Harris <tharris@acmedata.com>

Cc: Acme Data Procurement <procurement@acmedata.com>, Emily Zhou <emily.zhou@acmedata.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Oct 2027 13:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Acme Data – vendor activation: SLA & PO intake kickoff

Priya —

Thanks for the clear checklist. I’ve attached Acme’s standard vendor intake form and our procurement terms. Quick answers below: 

- Primary invoicing contact: accounting.ap@acmedata.com (AP inbox), CC: invoices+redwood@acmedata.com
- PO requirement: Yes, PO must be referenced on invoices. Standard net-45 terms (we can discuss if you need net-30).
- Support/escalation: Primary support contact for initial activation will be me (tharris@acmedata.com). For sev1 paging outside business hours please use the on-call rotation: Pager: +1 (617) 555-2490 (after-hours), and emergency Slack channel #acme-ops.
- SLA targets: Procurement prefers 99.95% for production endpoints and 30-minute sev1 acknowledgement during business hours, 2 hours after-hours. If Redwood’s standard is 99.9% we’d like to see a deviation record and compensating credits.

I’m looping Emily from Legal for any contract redlines (see attached). We aim to route the PO this week and expect signature within 7–10 business days once legal clears. Let me know if you want to chat — I’m free Thurs morning ET.

Best,
Tom

--
Tom Harris
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Data Systems
tharris@acmedata.com
(617) 555-0124

Attachments: acme_vendor_intake_form.pdf (PDF, 42KB); acme_procurement_terms_2027.pdf (PDF, 56KB)
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Tom Harris <tharris@acmedata.com>, Acme Data Procurement <procurement@acmedata.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Oct 2027 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme Data – vendor activation: SLA & PO intake kickoff

Tom — appreciate the quick turnaround and the details. A couple of clarifying items from our side before we move to PO: 

1) Uptime / credits: Redwood offers 99.9% by default for Hosted API and a 99.95% option for Dedicated with a small commitment and price delta. If Acme needs 99.95% we will document the pricing delta and include it in the SOW; I can send a short matrix.

2) Sev1 acknowledgement: our standard SLA is 1 hour during business hours and 3 hours after-hours. We can align on 30 minutes during business hours if Acme provides an escalation CLA (contact list + on-call response expectations) — that helps our ops on-call prioritize.

3) Billing: net-45 is OK; please provide the exact PO routing address format (we prefer invoice number in the subject to auto-match but will adhere to the PO field).

Dylan — can you attach the support activation checklist (service accounts, webhook endpoints, SSO details, and monitoring hooks)? Priya — once we receive the signed PO and the billing contact we’ll create the vendor in our system and open the onboarding ticket.

Laura

--
Laura Bennett
Head of Commercial Ops
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
From: Emily Zhou <emily.zhou@acmedata.com>

Date: Fri, 15 Oct 2027 16:02:00 -0400
Subject: Fwd: Acme Data – vendor activation: SLA & PO intake kickoff

Hi all — forwarding Acme Legal’s quick notes after an initial review. We made two narrow redlines: (1) liability cap tied to a multiple of fees (typical for us), and (2) SLA credit language clarified for partial-month incidents. Neither should block the PO routing; we can accept Redwood’s standard indemnity paragraph if Redwood provides SOC 2 evidence (we have the intake form).

Tom asked me to confirm that Procurement will still route the PO even if Legal tracks redlines in parallel (yes). We expect to issue the PO by 10/20 and will include the PO number in the invoice. Emily (legal) suggests a short call with Laura to reconcile the SLA credit language before signature — 30 minutes should do it.

Emily
